picks.editorial_note: A $15M gift from the OpenAI Foundation to build an open-source pharmacokinetic dataset marks a rare direct AI-industry investment in shared scientific infrastructure, aimed at making drug behavior prediction models better for the whole field.
picks.title: A Gift to Help Scientists Predict How Drugs Behave in the Body

picks.editorial_note: SRI's $26.5M ARPA-H award to build an AI 'co-pilot' for rural medical care tackles a real access-to-care gap with a concrete, near-deployable clinical tool, not just a research prototype.
picks.title: Reuters covers SRI's work in the ARPA-H-funded PARADIGM program - SRI

picks.editorial_note: NSF's addition of an AI-for-Physical-Systems funding call to its $1.5B X-Labs initiative signals a major federal bet on AI as core infrastructure for future breakthrough science, not just a research topic.
picks.title: NSF announces 3 additional topics as part of the NSF X-Labs initiative to pursue generational breakthrough science and technology efforts

picks.editorial_note: DARPA's new prize competition for autonomous trauma surgical robotics pushes AI from decision-support toward physically acting on patients independently, a significant and high-stakes real-world application.
picks.title: $3.5M to advance autonomous trauma robotics

picks.editorial_note: Unifying protein sequence and 3D structure in a single language model advances the fundamental toolkit for mapping evolutionary relationships across the entire protein universe, a high scientific-impact contribution.
picks.title: Uniting sequence and structure to map the protein universe | Science Tokyo

picks.editorial_note: UCLA's self-organized nanowire networks that compute as physical hardware point toward a fundamentally different, energy-efficient way to build neural networks, a novel direction beyond conventional silicon AI accelerators.
picks.title: Toward physical AI: When the hardware becomes the neural network

picks.editorial_note: Integrating EPFL/ETH Zurich's open-source Apertus model into Proton's privacy-focused Lumo assistant puts academically-developed AI in front of tens of millions of users, a rare case of open research reaching mass-market deployment.
picks.title: Apertus partners with Proton's Lumo AI assistant

picks.editorial_note: Rutgers and RWJBarnabas Health's AWS-powered Innovation Hub is a concrete academic-industry-clinical partnership structured to move AI from research into hospital practice.
picks.title: Rutgers and RWJBarnabas Health to Launch Innovation Hub, Powered by Amazon Web Services

picks.editorial_note: NSF's ELEGANT program to translate low-dimensional semiconductor research into U.S. manufacturing is a direct policy move to secure domestic chip supply for AI and high-performance computing.
picks.title: NSF invests in translating low-dimensional semiconductor technologies to establish U.S. leadership in microelectronics

picks.editorial_note: A DOE Genesis Mission-funded project applying AI to reason over decades of nuclear waste safety data shows federal AI policy priorities extending into high-consequence regulatory domains.
picks.title: AI project reviews nuclear waste safety-case evidence
